assessment.summary: This study investigates insecticide resistance mechanisms in an Anopheles funestus population from Pahou, Benin. It reports high resistance to DDT, permethrin, and bendiocarb, but susceptibility to malathion. Genotyping for kdr (L1014F) and Ace-1 (G119S) mutations in 50 field-collected mosquitoes showed no presence of these mutations. Metabolic resistance mechanisms were explored via biochemical assays and qPCR, identifying overexpression of GSTe2, CYP6P9a, and CYP6P9b.
